TWO INFERENCE POINTS, both verified true against other sources rather than fabricated. (a) ano '1o ano - Ciclo Biomedico': the programa PDF states only 'Insercion: Ciclo biomedico' (L207) and never says first year. I fetched the plan cited by the parent node (https://www.fmed.uba.ar/sites/default/files/2018-04/PLAN%20DE%20ESTUDIOS.pdf) and Bioetica I is listed under 'CICLO BIOMEDICO / Primer ano' alongside Anatomia, Histologia, Salud Mental and Medicina Familiar I. Cross-node grounding, consistent with nodes/uba.med.medicina.json which also assigns role '1o ano'. (b) catedra 'Unidad Academica de Bioetica': the string appears nowhere in the PDF. I fetched the live catedra page http://www.fmed.uba.ar/departamentos_y_catedras/unidad-academica-de-bioetica/programa-de-ensenanza, which is titled 'Unidad Academica de Bioetica' and carries under a 'Programas Curriculares' heading the exact sentence 'Para los y las estudiantes del plan 2009 que adeuden la materia Bioetica I y/o Bioetica II para rendir examen en mesa general pueden descargar el programa en los enlaces mas abajo', followed by list items 'Asignatura BIOETICA I (.pdf)' and 'Asignatura BIOETICA II (.pdf)'. This corroborates both the catedra attribution and the node frame's claim 'el mismo que la facultad ofrece descargar para rendir en mesa general' — that phrase is not embellishment, it is close to a paraphrase of the publisher's own page. Caveat worth recording: those two list items currently render with NO href (the Drupal attachments widget below them is empty), so the page-to-PDF link is presently broken on the live site; the attribution rests on the page text plus the PDF being hosted on the same fmed.uba.ar domain, not on a resolvable anchor. CURRENCY FINDING (report only, not a grounding defect). The same catedra page shows that the programa currently in force is a DIFFERENT document: 'El programa de ensenanza de la Materia Bioetica aprobado por resolucion CD 241/2024', a single unified materia with 'CARGA HORARIA: - Total de horas: 48 hs', organized around competencias and rights-based objetivos (derecho a la intimidad, a la vida, al proyecto de vida autonoma, a la identidad, a la salud, derechos en sujetos de investigacion) rather than the 11-unidad principles-and-rules skeleton. The node's 20-hs 'Bioetica I' is therefore the legacy plan-2009 programa retained for mesa general, not the 2024 syllabus. The node's frame half-acknowledges this via the mesa-general sentence but never states the 48-hs 2024 programa exists or that Bioetica I is plan-2009 legacy. A reader would reasonably assume this is the current first-year syllabus. Recommend adding a currency line to the frame or a metadata field noting Res. CD 241/2024 superseded it; this is an honesty-of-framing improvement, not a fabricated exit. I attempted to refute this node on every axis — invented unidades, invented or padded bibliography, inflated hours, misattributed catedra, wrong extract file — and found no fabrication. Every one of the 18 exits is recoverable verbatim from the cited text, and both metadata claims that exceed the cited text are independently true against fmed.uba.ar. No files were edited.
